evidence_levels.B: authoritative identity established but local copy not cryptographically matched
evidence_levels.C: credible copy but publisher provenance unresolved

method: A local PDF is treated as matched when a copy fetched from the publisher of record agrees with it page for page on extracted text, page geometry and embedded-image digests, after removing repository viewer stamps. SHA-256 equality is reported when it occurs but is not required: fifteen of the twenty-one corpus PDFs are browser re-encodings whose container hash can never match the publisher's.

sources.official_title: The Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 (Act 23 of 1940)
sources.publisher: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation, Directorate General of Health Services, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sources.source_evidence_level_reason: All 635 pages of the compendium match the CDSCO copy on text, geometry and embedded images. Both logical documents in this compendium inherit the verdict from the same physical file.
sources.local_evidence: Title page names the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and states 'as amended up to 31st December 2016'.
sources.notes: STALE by nine years, and amended since: the Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2026 amends section 27A of this Act (confirmed in the Gazette text at Serial 22 of its Schedule). CDSCO publishes the Act separately, released 22 November 2022.

sources.official_title: The Drugs Rules, 1945
sources.publisher: CDSCO, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sources.source_evidence_level_reason: Verified through the same physical compendium as IN-DC-ACT-1940: all 635 pages match the CDSCO copy.
sources.local_evidence: Compendium title page, 'as amended up to 31st December 2016'.
sources.notes: STALE by eight years, and the replacement has been acquired and its currency read from the document itself: the CDSCO consolidated Drugs Rules, 1945 runs to 963 pages and its front matter states '[As amended vide G.S.R. 360(E) dated 01-07-2024 (w.e.f. 01-07-2024)]'. That is 366 pages more than the local Rules. Note also that the New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019 and the Cosmetics Rules, 2020 have since carved subject matter out of the 1945 Rules.

sources.source_evidence_level_reason: India Code identity established from the per-page stamp on all 86 pages, plus a Gazette masthead and 'PUBLISHED BY AUTHORITY' in the document. No MoEFCC or India Code copy could be fetched.

sources.official_title: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (Act No. 18 of 2003)
sources.source_evidence_level_reason: A credible consolidated text with no publisher imprint: no India Code stamp, no Gazette masthead, no 'As on' line. The NBA's historical deep links now redirect to its homepage and no copy could be fetched for comparison.
sources.local_evidence: None beyond the title and arrangement of sections.

sources.official_title: The Copyright Act, 1957 (Act No. 14 of 1957)
sources.publisher: Copyright Office, Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
sources.source_evidence_level_reason: The local file carries no publisher imprint of any kind — no India Code stamp, no Gazette masthead, no 'As on' line — and it does not match the Copyright Office copy, which runs to 52 pages against the local 57. Two different consolidations of the same Act; which publisher produced the local one is unresolved.
sources.local_evidence: None. The document states only its title and Act number.
sources.notes: Both copies predate a passed amendment. The Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2026, Serial 23 of its Schedule, omits section 67; section 67 ('Penalty for making false entries in register') is still present in full in the local copy AND in the Copyright Office copy. Commencement is by notification under section 1(2) and no commencement notification was located, so the amendment's in-force date is unconfirmed. Replace with the Copyright Office copy for provenance, and re-check once a post-commencement consolidation appears.

sources.official_title: Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (Annex 1C to the Marrakesh Agreement Establishing the World Trade Organization)
sources.publisher: World Trade Organization
sources.source_evidence_level_reason: WTO authorship is established from the document's own footnote, which is the WTO's standard amendment note. Two WTO PDFs were downloaded and neither matches on page count (local 31; WTO unamended 33; WTO amended 36), so the exact WTO rendering the local file came from was not identified.
sources.local_evidence: Footnote a: 'The TRIPS Agreement was amended through the Protocol Amending the TRIPS Agreement, done at Geneva on 6 December 2005, which entered into force on 23 January 2017... This file reproduces the 1994 unamended version.'
sources.notes: SUBSTANTIVELY OUT OF DATE, and this is the finding that shows why 'treaties do not go stale' is the wrong rule. The local copy states on its own face that it is the 1994 unamended text. It therefore lacks Article 31bis and the Annex and Appendix inserted by the 2005 Protocol, which entered into force on 23 January 2017 — the compulsory-licensing-for-export provisions most relevant to public health and pharmaceutical patents. The WTO now serves the amended text as the default. Whether India has accepted the Protocol was not confirmed from a WTO source in this phase and must be established before the amended text is treated as binding on India.

sources.official_title: Food Safety and Standards (Ayurveda Aahara) Regulations, 2022
sources.publisher: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sources.source_evidence_level_reason: No publisher copy of the Regulations was obtained. The only text of the Regulations available to the project is a commercial legal database rendering, which §2 excludes as a source of record.
sources.notes: The most Ayurveda-specific instrument on the expected list, and the corpus does not contain it. What the corpus has instead is the FSSAI covering Order of 25 July 2025 (registered as IN-FSSAI-AYURVEDA-AAHARA-2022) whose filename claims to be these Regulations. Made under section 92(2)(v) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006; draft published 30 June 2021, gazette copies released to the public 5 July 2021, final notification dated 5 May 2022. The FSSAI gazette URL located in this phase serves the site's JavaScript shell rather than a PDF, and the FSSAI 'Ayurveda Aahara Compendium' turns out to be another recipe index. Acquisition probably needs a browser session against the FSSAI portal or a request to FSSAI directly.
